propositions: The Git version floor gate step hard-fails when .github/git-version-floor.txt is absent from the checked-out patchset tree, even though the workflow definition (which includes the gate) comes from the target branch.
In-flight changes branched before the gate landed fail CI with '::error::missing' despite having adequate Git versions, because the patchset tree predates the data file.
The gate violates the documented ee2a convention that requires an if-present guard with a skip on absence, which two adjacent gate steps already implement.
The false failures send authors hunting for a file they never touched instead of naming the real cause (change predates gate) and remedy (re-enforces on rebase/post-merge).
Applying the established if-present pattern to skip when the floor file is absent preserves 980d's enforcement for trees that do have the file while self-healing on rebase and post-merge.
